info.description: Customer reviews migrated from WordPress CPT "reviews"

review_date.description: When the borrower left the review. Renders only when set - migration createdAt is NOT a review date (honesty rule).

verified_borrower.description: Set only when our systems confirm a funded application (Master Doc s17). Gates the visible flag AND schema.org Review markup.

product_label.description: Which product the review concerns, e.g. 'Term loan'

company.description: A review belongs to exactly one of lender or company

subject_type.description: Prevents a review attaching to both

product_used.description: Which product the reviewer actually used

moderated_at.description: Every review passes a human before publishing

reviewer_region.description: Province only. No city, no identifying detail.
